generation.scope: All transverse doublet Klein windows are covered, with no assumption on zero coefficients, by one family of unordered distinct points of P1. The 51 sparse supports have 63 coefficient components; 61 fail a character-resolved Hilbert test. One point and one torus are regular and give precisely the missing infinity boundary, including its rank-twelve specializations. Every object has period one, and reversal preserves its indexed class. Full unmarked redundancy of the projective parameters is still open.

open_mathematics: Determine the unmarked identifications on the transverse projective surface using intrinsic contractions, and solve the parallel-direction (2,2,1,1) rectangular supports and dense exceptional fibers.
